motion: bouncing up and down with excitement

keys.pose: at the lowest point of the bounce; the two feet are folded up flat against the underside of the body; both short arms are out and downward at about 30 degrees from the sides of the body; a gentle closed-mouth smile
pushing off; the two feet reach straight down below the body, hanging well clear of the belly; both short arms are out and downward at about 45 degrees from the sides of the body; a small open smile
rising; the two feet still reach down below the body, trailing under the rising body; both short arms are out at about 70 degrees from the sides of the body; a wide open smile

rising and slowing; the two feet are drawn part way up under the body, bent at the middle; both short arms are out at about 90 degrees from the sides of the body, level with the shoulders; a wide open smile

at the very top of the bounce; the two feet are tucked up close under the body, almost touching the belly; both short arms are up and outward at about 100 degrees from the sides of the body; a wide open smile with a small pink tongue
beginning to fall; the two feet are still tucked up close under the body; both short arms are out at about 90 degrees from the sides of the body, level with the shoulders; a wide open smile
falling; the two feet swing down below the body, half extended; both short arms are out at about 70 degrees from the sides of the body; a small open smile

about to land; the two feet reach straight down below the body, hanging well clear of the belly; both short arms are out and downward at about 45 degrees from the sides of the body; a gentle closed-mouth smile

invariants: two long upright ears whose bases sit on top of the head, two eyes, one mouth, two short arms, two feet; two pink oval inner ears; two round pink cheek blushes; the canvas holds only this one character
poseConstants: each eye is a large round dark eye with a small white highlight near its top, exactly as in Image 1; the character faces the viewer straight on, the two ears stand straight up and stay symmetric left and right, and both eyes are always mirror images of each other; each short arm is a small rounded nub on the outer edge of the body silhouette; below the body there are exactly two feet, side by side and close together, each foot one smooth rounded oval in the same plain white surface as the body; the body keeps normal proportions in every frame; the whole canvas outside the character is one flat white surface
